free_text: Given the rising PSA trend and the high-risk PI-RADS 5 finding, a biopsy is indicated to further characterize the disease, as supported by the weighted expert consensus. The decision was driven by the rising PSA trend and the PI-RADS 5 lesion, as the documented prior ISUP Group 3 diagnosis did not preclude further investigation.
